title: Runtime Initialization
summary: The `Runtime` coordinates the tick loop, ECS worlds, platform windows, and audio playback. It requires a transport backend (`@galfus/transport-bun`, `@galfus/transport-node`, or `@galfus/transport-browser`).

title: Multiverse Presentation Graph
summary: A **Realm** (`Realm3D` or `Realm2D`) represents an isolated simulation space containing entities, lights, and cameras. A **Presentation Target** represents a surface to draw onto (a desktop window or HTML5 canvas). An **Invocation** links a Realm to a Target through a specific camera slot.
